reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but implements daily occurrence filtering separately in three consumers.

duplication.why: The daily weekend-and-holiday exclusion predicate appears four times across getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers also own scheduling policy that should reside alongside the shared date-selection logic.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested daily skipping, range handler, and holiday extensions.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate duplicated daily-selection rules and separate occurrence-fetch sizing formulas instead of changing one shared policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement the daily occurrence-selection policy also implemented in shared getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily exclusion rule is expressed through array filters in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates and an imperative continue branch in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains two daily filtering branches and a branch bypassing adjustment; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement daily selection.
